_purpose: Declarative field inventory for DATEV-Format Buchungsstapel per Formatversion. Source: developer.datev.de portal, captured verbatim from the spec dumps in the PRD repo.

_provenance.transcription_method: verbatim from portal table cells (#, Überschrift, Ausdruck, Beschreibung columns)

_field_schema.name: Portal Überschrift verbatim — used as row-2 column header name unless overridden
_field_schema.regex: Interpreted regex used by the serializer for validation
_field_schema.regex_portal: Literal portal regex IF differs from regex (only present for portal inconsistencies)
_field_schema.interpretation_note: Explanation of any deviation from portal regex (only present for portal inconsistencies)
_field_schema.quoted: true if field value is wrapped in " in output; numeric fields are unquoted
_field_schema.row2_override: If present, this string replaces the default 'name' for the row-2 column-header row (per PRD §6 — Einstieg-page-example overrides for fields #1, #8)

13._status: PORTAL-verified 2026-05-22 for Formatversion 13 (current as of February 2024 per portal Changelog)

header_fields.name: Kennzeichen
header_fields.note: EXTF = Export aus 3rd-Party App; DTVF = Export aus DATEV App

header_fields.name: Versionsnummer
header_fields.note: Only valid value per portal regex

header_fields.name: Formatversion
header_fields.interpretation_note: Portal regex omits 3 but description includes 3 = Sachkontenbeschriftungen. v2.1.0 emits only 13 (Buchungsstapel) so this is moot in practice; interpretation follows description.

header_fields.name: Festschreibung
header_fields.note: 0 = keine Festschreibung; 1 = Festschreibung (portal default). Plugin default is 0 for pilot per PRD [STB-DECISION].

data_columns.name: Umsatz
data_columns.note: Positiv, nicht 0,00; max 10 Vorkomma- und 2 Nachkommastellen

data_columns.name: Skontosperre
data_columns.interpretation_note: Portal regex is a character class [0|1] accepting literal pipe; almost certainly a typo. Serializer enforces alternation ^(0|1)$.

data_columns.name: Generalumkehr
data_columns.interpretation_note: Portal regex accepts only 0/1; description says 'G oder 1 = Generalumkehr'. Serializer accepts input G or 1 or true, normalizes to output "1".

data_columns.name: BVV-Position
data_columns.interpretation_note: Portal regex is a character class accepting literal pipe; almost certainly a typo. Serializer enforces alternation ^(1|2|3|4|5)$.

4._status: PORTAL-verified 2026-05-22 for Formatversion 4 (current per portal Anhang). 101 fields. Cross-ref XML: Format_Wiederkehrende Buchungen.xml in DATEV-Format-Prüfprogramm zip.
